stories.title: Cadw confirms half-term events at north Wales castles within reach of Flintshire
stories.summary: Cadw has confirmed a programme of half-term events at six north Wales sites between Saturday 23 May and Sunday 31 May. Plas Mawr will host an event called Wise Woman across the half-term period. stories.title: Mineshaft discovery forces changes to 300-home Hawarden development
stories.summary: Changes to construction plans on a 300-home development in Hawarden due to an incorrectly mapped mine shaft have been approved by Flintshire’s Planning Committee. stories.title: Chester: Cyclist dies in Hoole Bridge collision as Toyota driver flees scene
stories.summary: A cyclist has died after a collision on Hoole Bridge in Chester in the early hours of Thursday, and the driver of a silver Toyota Yaris fled the scene on foot. stories.title: Four nights of overnight A494 slip closures coming to Ewloe in June
stories.summary: Traffic Wales has confirmed four consecutive nights of overnight slip road closures at Ewloe Interchange next month, running from Monday 15 June to Friday 19 June. stories.title: North Wales Police share Staffordshire force appeal for wanted man
stories.summary: North Wales Police are asking the public to help locate a 29-year-old man with links to north Wales and Merseyside who is wanted by Staffordshire Police. Liam Richards, from Newcastle-under-Lyme, is wanted by Staffordshire Police in connection with threats to kill, criminal damage, assault, affray and failing to appear at court.
